capabilities.name: product-aggregate-read
capabilities.description: Read the m_collateral_management product row (id, name, quality, base_price, unit_type, pct_to_base, currency) by its primary key, as returned by the product read-back.
capabilities.evidence: Capture collateral-product-readback-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the single product row (id 2, name SEED-Collateral-Product, quality Good, basePrice 100000.00000, unitType 1, pctToBase 50.00000, currency MNT).

capabilities.name: collateral-type-link
capabilities.description: Read the m_loan_collateral row (id, type_cv_id) by its primary key, as returned by the loan-collateral read-back.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-collateral-readback-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the single link row (id 2, type.id 24), keyed by the LoanCollateral code value.

seams.name: collateral-product-read
seams.description: GET the collateral product read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_collateral_management aggregate row.

seams.name: collateral-link-read
seams.description: GET the loan-collateral read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_loan_collateral aggregate row.

note: Collateral parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Two capabilities are graded: the product aggregate read (collateral-product-read seam) and the loan-collateral type_cv_id link read (collateral-link-read seam). The valuation arithmetic (ClientCollateral.Total / TotalCollateral, i.e. basePrice*pctToBase/100*quantity) is NOT in the graded domain: the running oracle exposed no API read-back that computes it, so no vector may require it.
